benchmarks.protocol: crates/core/examples/lex.rs on the published file: Lex's beam search (3 beams) on 43 words and phrases of the seven languages, 20 rounds, one thread, the median of several passes; with the engine's own time per run of each plan (crates/engine/examples/bench.rs, 3000 runs). Measured 2026-10-20.

metrics.ms_per_word: ms per word, the beam search whole
metrics.encoder_us: µs per run of the encoder (once per word)
metrics.decoder_us: µs per run of the decoder (once per step)
